description_en: Queries available resources by calling DescribeAvailableResource
kebab_example: aliyun hbase describe-available-resource --charge-type Prepaid --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --zone-id cn-hangzhou-h --engine hbaseue --engine-version 2.0 --core-instance-type hbase.sn1.large --disk-type cloud_ssd --api-version 2019-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeAvailableResource

parameters.help_en:
The billing method. Valid values:
Prepaid: subscription.
PostPaid: pay-as-you-go
parameters.help_zh:
付费方式，取值：
Prepaid：包年包月（预付费）。
PostPaid：按量付费（后付费）
parameters.name: charge_type

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/144489.html operation to query the region ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The zone. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/144489.html operation to query available zones
parameters.name: zone_id

parameters.help_en:
The service type of the instance. Valid values:
hbase: ApsaraDB for HBase Standard Edition standard instance.
hbaseue: ApsaraDB for HBase Performance-enhanced Edition standard instance.
singlehbase: ApsaraDB for HBase single-node standard instance.
bds: Data Synchronization (BDS) service
parameters.help_zh:
实例的服务类型。取值：
hbase：表示云数据库HBase标准版实例。
hbaseue：表示云数据库HBase增强版实例。
singlehbase：表示云数据库HBase单节点实例。
bds：表示数据同步（BDS）服务
parameters.name: engine

parameters.help_en:
The version number of the service type. Valid values:
1.0: The Data Synchronization (BDS) service supports version 1.0.
1.1: ApsaraDB for HBase Standard Edition standard instances and ApsaraDB for HBase single-node standard instances support version 1.1.
2.0: ApsaraDB for HBase Standard Edition standard instances, ApsaraDB for HBase Performance-enhanced Edition standard instances, and ApsaraDB for HBase single-node standard instances support version 2.0.

Specify the version number based on the service type of the ApsaraDB for HBase instance
parameters.help_zh:
实例的服务类型版本号。取值：
1.0：数据同步（BDS）服务支持1.0版本。
1.1：云数据库HBase标准版实例和云数据库HBase单节点实例支持1.1版本。
2.0：云数据库HBase标准版实例、云数据库HBase增强版实例和云数据库HBase单节点实例支持2.0版本。

请根据云数据库HBase实例的服务类型填写对应的版本号
parameters.name: engine_version

parameters.help_en: The specifications of the core node. For more information about valid values, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/194870.html
parameters.help_zh: 实例的Core节点规格，更多取值请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/194870.html
parameters.name: core_instance_type

parameters.help_en:
The disk type of the core node. Valid values:
cloud_efficiency: ultra cloud disk
cloud_ssd: standard SSD
cloud_essd_pl1: ESSD
local_hdd_pro: local HDD
local_ssd_pro: local SSD
parameters.help_zh:
实例的Core磁盘类型，取值：
cloud_efficiency：高效云盘
cloud_ssd：SSD云盘
cloud_essd_pl1：ESSD云盘
local_hdd_pro：本地HDD盘
local_ssd_pro：本地SSD盘
parameters.name: disk_type
